title: Character Asset, Rig, Garment Projection & LOD Production Pipeline
objective: Provide deterministic character-asset, rig, garment-projection and LOD production preparation over completed PCA recipe/graph/material foundations while preserving Character, Species/Form, equipment/garment, presentation and ARI owner authority and keeping generated derivatives distinct from canonical anatomy, ownership or Character mechanics.

scope.purpose: Prepare provider/DCC-independent character media derivatives, rig/garment projections and LOD plans over existing canonical owner references without inventing anatomy, Form, equipment ownership or Character mechanics and without bypassing ARI resource/provenance/rights authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative authorized Character/Species/Form/garment and ARI-governed inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable character-asset, rig, garment-projection and LOD derivative plans with stable provenance and fail-closed invalid owner/reference/rights/adapter states, while preserving canonical Character/Species/Form/equipment authority and never treating generated projections as canonical anatomy, ownership or mechanics.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-04 exact-tree publication. PCA-04 unlocks no rotation gate; MCS remains blocked by PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER, so PCA-05 is the lawful next PCA item.
PCA-05 is selected only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it.
PCA-01..04 remain completed foundations and must not be silently reimplemented or weakened.
Character, Species/Form, equipment/garment and presentation owner domains retain canonical anatomy, identity, ownership and mechanics authority; PCA-05 is production tooling only.

ARI retains resource identity, source/derivative lineage, bytes/reference state and rights/use authority; generated character media remains candidate derivative output until owner-governed registration/acceptance.
Detailed PCA-05 Character/Species/Form/PAPT/CAPP/ARI owner seams are deferred to governed start targeted loading rather than guessed at selection time.
PCA-06+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this selection.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start PCA-05. Do not implement PCA-05 while selected_not_started.
